title: Neighborhood Play Garden
description: One static neighborhood play-garden scene under the original community-park program. A full A-frame swing and a full fixed roundabout occupy separate left and right activity bays. A whole young conifer anchors the rear-left green edge, and a complete bench stands beside the front approach. Three nonoverlapping scene-only thin paving strips form an entry stem and two rear branches on one garden base, separating the two activity bays rather than merely grouping toys on a shelf. Four complete unchanged unit-scale published models, one scene preset and zero new independent models. Not the earlier seesaw/slide corner, low sand/crawl/rider stations, climbing/rest bay, or village well courtyard. Static game-art composition only: no moving rides, operating envelope, safe clearance, child age suitability, accessible path, rooted-tree growth or structural safety certification.
